memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "He will bring you to the land that belonged to your ancestors, and you will take possession of it. He will make you more prosperous and numerous than your ancestors. The Lord your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, so that you may love him with all your heart and with all your soul, and live." — Deut 30:5-6 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God promised not only to restore His people but to bless them beyond what they had known before. Yet the greatest promise here is not about land or numbers — it is those stunning words: "The Lord your God will circumcise your hearts." This is one of the most important verses in the Old Testament. God promises to do a deep, inward work, cutting away the hardness of the heart so His people can truly love Him.

This is crucial, because it reveals what our real problem is. The issue was never simply that Israel needed to try harder to obey. The issue was the condition of the heart — a heart naturally hard, resistant, unable to love God as it should. And the solution was something only God could do. He alone can change the heart.

Notice the beautiful logic: God circumcises the heart "so that you may love him." He does the inward work first, and love and obedience flow out as the result. Real transformation is God's gift, not our achievement.

This promise finds its fulfilment in the new covenant, where God gives us a new heart and puts His Spirit within us (Ezek 36:26-27). Through Christ, we receive "circumcision of the heart, by the Spirit" (Rom 2:29). If you long to love God more, this is wonderful news: He is the one who works that love within you. Ask Him to do the deep heart-work only He can do, and then watch love for Him grow.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I recognise that my deepest need is a changed heart, not just harder effort?
2. Am I asking God to do the inward work only He can do?
3. How does it encourage me that love for God is His gift to grow in me?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, my heart is hard and my love is weak, but You promise to do a deep inward work. Circumcise my heart by Your Spirit, that I may truly love You with all my heart and soul. Amen.
